# Home Owner Resources: Flood

# Home Owner Resources: Flood

Created OnAugust 7, 2018

Last Updated OnFebruary 10, 2020

You are here:

- KB Home
- Home Owner Resources: Flood

&lt; Back

The City of Valley City participates in the National Flood Insurance Program Community Rating System at a Class 9. This program recognizes the efforts Valley City has taken for effective floodplain management and benefits property owners with lower flood insurance premiums.

[National Flood Insurance Program](https://www.floodsmart.gov) is available for residential and commercial properties. *Additional information about the National Flood Insurance Program is provided by [FEMA](https://www.fema.gov/national-flood-insurance-program).*

[ND State Water Commission Risk Assessment Map,](https://ndram.swc.nd.gov) a searchable flood hazard zone map.

The City of Valley City has developed a Permanent Flood Protection Plan. *Updates on the project as well as flood related maps are available online.* 

Barnes County has developed a *[Hazard Mitigation Plan](https://www.co.barnes.nd.us/MHMPsigned.pdf).*
